Doctoral Studies
Admission
Admission
Application documentation is always handed in to the Academic Services department (Doctoral Administration). The Vice Rector for Doctoral Studies evaluates the application.
External thesis projects
External thesis projects (projects carried out outside the ETH domain) have to be approved by the Doctoral Commission of the department.
Further information
Further information on requirements, admission, and registration procedures is available on the ETH Zürich website .
